title: GLM example recommended image r5
summary: Fictional maintainer-supported image that incorporates the tested scheduler bound and replaces r4.

base_image.credit: Fictional Local Inference Lab maintainers and contributors

recommended_image.relationship: Current recommended image for the GLM example family

community_wiki.relationship: Community wiki landing page used to locate current model-family guidance; this record remains a fictional format example.

pull_requests.title: Bound the fictional scheduler diagnostic queue

inherited: The preceding recommended image supplies the fictional GLM profile and qualified B12X runtime.
introduced: The tested scheduler diagnostic bound is incorporated into the recommended source composition.
compatibility_impact: Diagnostic clients receive at most 1,024 pending entries; serving defaults remain unchanged.

tested_configurations.name: Recommended four-GPU qualification
tested_configurations.hardware: 4 x fictional SM120 GPUs with 96 GiB each
tested_configurations.topology: Single-socket PCIe topology; peer access enabled
tested_configurations.speculative_mode: Disabled for target-only control; separately qualified MTP3 profile recorded in evidence
tested_configurations.cache_policy: Dedicated fresh JIT volume for every compared profile
tested_configurations.launch_command: docker run --rm --gpus all --network host -e TP=4 -e MAX_NUM_SEQS=30 -e CUDAGRAPH_MODE=FULL registry.example.org/community/vllm:glm-example-recommended-r5@sha256:9999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999

results.name: Recommended correctness gate
results.conditions: Clean recommended image and listed model revision.
results.measurement: Focused unit tests plus Estonia 30 by 30 high-reasoning run.
results.result: Focused tests passed and Estonia scored 29 of 30.
results.conclusion: The listed correctness gate passed under the qualified configuration.

results.name: Recommended stability gate
results.conditions: Thirty concurrent requests with fresh cache and three repetitions.
results.measurement: Ninety requests plus server health and fatal-signature monitoring.
results.result: 90 of 90 completed; zero restarts and zero fatal signatures.

results.name: Recommended performance regression gate
results.conditions: r5 and r4 on identical hardware and fresh dedicated JIT volumes.
results.result: No tested cell regressed by more than 1.5%; C30 improved by 0.8%.
results.conclusion: The recommended performance regression gate passed for the tested matrix.

results.name: Image startup
results.conclusion: The image starts under the published launch configuration.

performance_claims.name: Recommended r5 target-only regression comparison
performance_claims.hardware: 4 x fictional SM120 GPUs; identical power and clocks
performance_claims.experimental_unit: One independently started and warmed server process on the fixed four-GPU host
performance_claims.run_order: Predeclared randomized ten-run order with five candidate and five control server starts
performance_claims.stopping_rule: Five independently started server runs per image
performance_claims.exclusions: None; failed runs would remain in the raw evidence
performance_claims.aggregation: Median aggregate tokens/second per cell; every run retained
changed_variables: Scheduler diagnostic snapshot bound incorporated in the recommended source composition
performance_claims.falsification_condition: A reproducible regression beyond the declared gate and repeated-control variation
performance_claims.absolute_effect: Candidate minus control ranged from -18 to +11 aggregate tokens/second across tested cells
performance_claims.relative_effect: Candidate minus control ranged from -1.5% to +0.8%; C30 improved by 0.8%
performance_claims.uncertainty: Across five independent runs per image, per-cell median absolute deviation was 0.4% to 0.9%; no population-level interval was claimed
performance_claims.result: No cell regressed by more than 1.5%; C30 improved by 0.8%.
performance_claims.conclusion: r5 passed the target-only performance regression gate on the tested matrix.
